functions.name: core_ble_set_services
functions.brief: Register a service builder function. Called before core_ble_init(). The builder is invoked during init after the GATT server is ready.

functions.name: core_ble_init
functions.brief: Initialize the BLE stack. Call once after core_init().

functions.name: core_ble_advertise
functions.brief: Start advertising. Call after init + at least one core_ble_process().

functions.name: core_ble_process
functions.brief: Process BLE events. Call continuously from main loop.

functions.name: core_ble_add_service
functions.brief: Add a GATT service. Returns a handle for adding characteristics. UUID is auto-generated from the service name.

functions.name: core_ble_add_char
functions.signature: core_ble_add_char(core_ble_svc_t svc, const char * name, uint8_t access, uint8_t type, core_ble_write_cb on_write, void * ctx)
functions.brief: Add a characteristic to a service.

params.name: on_write
params.description: Callback when central writes. NULL if read-only.

params.name: ctx
params.description: User context passed to on_write callback; may be NULL.

functions.name: core_ble_set_value
functions.signature: core_ble_set_value(core_ble_char_t ch, const void * data, uint16_t len)
functions.brief: Update a characteristic's value. For readable characteristics, this is what the central will read. For notify characteristics, call core_ble_notify() after to push the update.

functions.name: core_ble_notify
functions.brief: Send a notification to the connected central. The central must have enabled notifications (CCCD) for this to work. Sends the current value set by core_ble_set_value().

functions.name: core_ble_connected
functions.brief: Returns 1 if a central is connected.

params.name: ctx
params.description: User context passed to callback; may be NULL

params.name: ctx
params.description: User context passed to callback; may be NULL

functions.name: core_ble_enable_pairing
functions.brief: Enable OS-level pairing (Just Works). When enabled, the phone/computer will show a "Pair?" dialog. Once paired, the device auto-reconnects and appears in OS Bluetooth settings. Call before core_ble_init(). Default: disabled.
